title: The Polite Imperfect
goal: Make a polite request or enquiry with the imperfect: quería pedirle, venía a preguntar, llamaba para.
grammar: The imperfect as a polite form

items: I can make a polite request now with quería, venía a and llamaba para.
I can tell a polite imperfect from a real past.
I can use the new words for polite requests and for talking about writers and books.
